turns.text: No, that coworker's recommendation was pretty dark, so I wanted something purely lighthearted today. After that, I got a bit hungry and whipped up a DIY burrito bowl in my kitchen with some rice, black beans, and avocado.

turns.text: Haha, no, he knows the rules, but he definitely gave me those big puppy-dog eyes the whole time I was eating. Tom actually took him out for a quick walk a bit ago so I could have some quiet time.

turns.text: Good job, Tom! It sounds like you've got the perfect setup for a restful day. Are you planning on doing any sourdough baking later, or just keeping off your feet?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I think I'm going to keep resting the ankle today and skip the baking. Just more lounging and enjoying the quiet!
